frequency_question: How often do expiring bilateral water treaties receive negotiated successor agreements within 5 years of expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal transboundary water-sharing treaties with fixed expiration dates or renewal clauses; excludes internal water pacts and non-binding declarations.
